# Mike Automations

> We automate document requests, reminders and follow-ups for small accounting and bookkeeping firms. Live in 2-3 days. Runs for 14 days. You pay only if it works.

We build it. It runs. Then you pay. Workflow automation and custom internal systems for small service businesses in the UK and US. Payment only after 14 days of the system running, and only if it works. It starts with a free 15-minute call.

## Pricing (US dollars)
- Workflow automation (one process): $2,000 one-off. Founding price for the first 3 clients: $1,500
- Custom system: from $5,000 one-off
- Maintenance (optional): $150 a month

## Contact
- Website: https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/
- Email: mikelgershman@gmail.com

## Blog
- [All articles](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/)
- [MTD for Income Tax: Quarterly Update Workflow for Practices](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/making-tax-digital-income-tax-practice-workflow/): MTD for Income Tax turns one annual chase into four. How UK practices can organise records, reminders and quarterly updates without the scramble.
- [Client Onboarding Checklist for Accounting Firms](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/accounting-client-onboarding-checklist/): A step-by-step client onboarding checklist for small accounting firms: engagement letter, ID checks, access and first documents. Plus what to automate.
- [How to Get Clients to Send Documents on Time](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/get-clients-to-send-documents-on-time/): How accountants and bookkeepers can get clients to send records on time: personal lists, one upload link, a reminder schedule and clear deadlines.
- [Email Templates for Chasing Client Documents](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/document-chasing-email-templates/): Five copy-and-paste email templates for chasing client documents: first request, friendly reminder, deadline reminder, final notice and thank-you.
- [1099 Season Checklist for Bookkeepers (2026 Tax Year)](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/1099-season-checklist-bookkeepers/): A practical 1099-NEC checklist for bookkeepers: collect W-9s early, track who crosses the threshold, and meet the January deadline without the scramble.
- [What to Automate First in a Small Service Business](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/what-to-automate-first-small-business/): A simple way to choose your first automation: find the process that repeats every week, follows the same steps, and costs you most when it's forgotten.
- [Zapier vs Make vs n8n for a Small Business](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/zapier-vs-make-vs-n8n/): Zapier, Make or n8n? A plain-English comparison for small service businesses: ease of use, complex workflows, hosting and who each one suits.
- [Estimate Follow-Up Email Templates for Contractors](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/estimate-follow-up-email-templates-contractors/): Copy-and-paste follow-up emails and texts for contractors who send estimates and hear nothing back. Polite, short, and timed to win more jobs.
- [How to Reduce No-Shows for Service Appointments](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/reduce-appointment-no-shows/): Practical ways for service businesses to cut no-shows: confirmations, timed reminders, easy rescheduling and a clear policy. Plus what to automate.
- [How to Ask Every Customer for a Google Review](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/ask-for-google-reviews-automatically/): A simple, policy-safe way for service businesses to ask every customer for a Google review after the job, and why you shouldn't filter who gets asked.
- [AI in a Small Accounting Firm: What to Automate](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/ai-in-accounting-firms-what-to-automate/): Where AI genuinely helps a small accounting or bookkeeping firm today, where it doesn't, and how to keep a person in control of every client-facing step.
- [How Much Does Business Automation Cost?](https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/blog/business-automation-cost/): What workflow automation really costs a small business: the build, software and support. Honest pricing, and what drives the price up or down.
